description: Tenant-wide work queue of unresolved delivery-receipt variances — DR lines where the supplier-delivered cost and/or quantity differs from the sourced purchase order's line snapshot and no resolution decision (approve/reject/edit) has been recorded yet. Within-tolerance deltas are auto-approved at write time and never appear here. Each row carries varianceKinds (cost and/or quantity) plus the raw source/delivered values and deltas (delivered minus source). Ordered oldest-first (createdAt ascending) — it's a work queue. Paged: returns Total (pre-paging) plus the page; default 100, max 500. A client-pinned token sees only its own client's delivery receipts; an operator token sees the whole tenant's.
name: get_receipt_variances
title: Receipt Variances
